title: AutoRPG: Harnessing Systematic AI for Non-Intrusive Low-Latency Mobile RPG Combat
abstract: arXiv:2611.29673v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated combat in mobile RPGs plays a critical role in game quality assurance, requiring real-time behavior control that closely resembles human gameplay. However, existing approaches fail to satisfy these requirements, either because they lack fine-grained behavioral control or because they incur high inference latency. To address these challenges, we incorporate user gameplay experience to design AutoRPG, a systematic AI framework for automating mobile RPG combat. At a high level, AutoRPG decomposes the combat process into two stages: a high-level strategic planning phase that formulates the overall combat strategy, followed by a systematic execution phase powered by a suite of carefully designed lightweight modules encompassing target tracking, character movement, dodge maneuvering, and abnormal-state handling. translated_title: AutoRPG：利用系统性AI实现非侵入式低延迟的移动端RPG战斗自动化
translated_abstract: 移动端RPG游戏中的自动战斗在游戏质量保障中扮演着关键角色，要求实现与人类玩家操作高度相似的实时行为控制。然而，现有方法无法满足这些要求，原因要么是缺乏细粒度的行为控制能力，要么是推理延迟过高。为应对这些挑战，我们结合用户游戏体验设计了AutoRPG，这是一个用于移动端RPG战斗自动化的系统性AI框架。在高层次上，AutoRPG将战斗过程分解为两个阶段：首先是制定整体战斗策略的高层战略规划阶段，随后是由一套精心设计的轻量级模块驱动的系统性执行阶段，这些模块涵盖目标追踪、角色移动、闪避操控和异常状态处理。在《原神》、《鸣潮》和《明日方舟：终末地》三款热门移动端RPG上的实验表明，
tldr: AutoRPG提出了一种两阶段系统性AI框架，通过高层战略规划结合一套轻量级执行模块（目标追踪、角色移动、闪避、异常处理），实现了非侵入式、低延迟且具备细粒度行为控制的移动端RPG自动战斗。
en_tdlr: AutoRPG introduces a two-stage systematic AI framework that combines high-level strategic planning with a suite of lightweight execution modules (target tracking, movement, dodging, and abnormal-state handling) to achieve non-intrusive, low-latency automated combat with fine-grained behavioral control in mobile RPGs.
